decisions.decision: Use mountain-captain-v2-seed12802 (Recommended): rounded blackened helmet with ridge, riveted brow band and cheek guards, grey fur stole on the shoulders only, massive riveted pauldrons, blackened breastplate, mail sleeves, off-white split skirt (dye field), arms clear of the body: the heaviest silhouette of the three armies.
